reports.title: Nacimiento Lake dropped to 34 percent of its storage capacity, and fishing remained good
reports.text: Crappie continued to hold near stumps and laydowns in approximately 15 feet of water, where small live minnows and small swimbaits proved effective.

reports.title: Fishing was good at Hart Park
reports.text: Largemouth bass went after baby bass Senkos and Texas-rigged plastics in brown and purple.

reports.title: Fishing was fair at Buena Vista Lakes
reports.text: Fishing was fair at Buena Vista Lakes, with bass taking Senkos, Texas rigs, and swim jigs near the inlet and around the islands. A few bass were also caught on crankbaits and topwater lures. Catfish anglers did well using dip bait, cut sardines, and chicken liver, while crappie responded to small live minnows.

reports.title: At Ming Lake, bass action has steadily improved over the past couple of weeks
reports.text: At Ming Lake, bass action has steadily improved over the past couple of weeks.

reports.title: Bass fishing at River Walk continues to improve
reports.text: Bass fishing at River Walk continues to improve, with anglers finding the most consistent action during the early morning and late evening hours.

reports.title: Lake Isabella held steady at 25 percent of capacity, but fishing remains solid throughout the lake
reports.text: The 6th Annual Customer Appreciation Bass Tournament was held on October 3, with anglers battling tough conditions but still managing to bring in some quality fish. Chance Gerecke claimed big fish honors with a 9.84-pound largemouth. Outside of the tournament, bass fishing remains productive, with anglers finding fish in 5 to 20 feet of water around brush, rocky points, and main lake structure. The crappie bite has also improved, with anglers reporting quality stringers on live minnows and small minijigs around structure in 18 to 25 feet of water.

reports.title: Anglers reported good bass and striped bass fishing, with plenty of catfish mixed in
reports.text: Pyramid Lake sat at about 90% of its storage capacity, and anglers reported good bass and striped bass fishing, with plenty of catfish mixed in. Largemouth and smallmouth bass took Texas-rigged six-inch plastic worms in brown and dark green in 10 to 25 feet of water along bluff walls and near the island. The topwater bite produced bass and a few striped bass shortly after the lake opened, with walking baits leading the way. As the grass began to die off, some anglers found better bass fishing around rocky structure away from the deteriorating vegetation.

reports.title: The bite slowed slightly following the last cold front
reports.text: The bite slowed slightly following the last cold front, but local bass anglers continued to connect along bluff walls using drop-shot Senkos and smaller-profile plastics in cinnamon, shad, and green pumpkin. The topwater bite was hit or miss, with some bass still feeding occasionally near the backs of coves.
